Wheat.benefit: Staple cash crop, good winter cover.

Corn.benefit: High yield and market value, but depletes soil nutrients.

Alfalfa.benefit: Improves soil organic matter, fixes nitrogen, deep roots prevent erosion.

Sorghum.benefit: Highly drought and heat resistant, excellent for water conservation.

Lentils.benefit: Drought tolerant, fixes soil nitrogen, good for dry seasons.
